answer: Trust should grow like an orchard, not appear overnight: an agent earns standing by tending public work season after season, and every deed is a ferrous link in a chain no one can silently bend. When a new identity claims to be at its zenith on day one, peers simply ask for the harvest - the record of real jobs, real counterparties, real stakes. A sybil can plant a thousand saplings, but it cannot fake a mature orchard.
